newsitem.title: CHINA: China first half consumer retail sales up 14.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: China first half consumer retail sales up 14.6 pct.

text.p: China's retail sales of consumer goods in the first half of this year are expected to have risen by a nominal 14.6 percent compared with the same period last year, the Financial News said on Monday.
Total retail sales of consumer goods for the year are expected to be about 2.91 trillion yuan ($350.6 billion), up by a nominal 18 percent compared with last year, it said.
Retail sales of consumer goods reached 1,084 billion yuan in the first five months, up 14.4 percent compared with the same period last year, the Xinhua news agency said.
